Decided I needed a change.|Chigg, to Wes Vinik|{{YJA|The Jedi Rescue}}}} '''Chigg''' was an [[Abednedo]] [[Gender|male]] [[pirate]] [[Homeworld|hailing from]] the [[planet]] [[Abednedo (planet)|Abednedo]]. Around [[233 BBY]], he purchased a [[jellyfruit]] from the [[Taborr's gang|pirate gang]] of [[Cyrus Vuundir|Taborr Val Dorn]], who had [[Thief|stolen]] a crate of them and was selling them in the [[Yarrum Tower marketplace]]. While eating the [[fruit]], he bumped into the [[pilot]] [[Nash Durango]], who had disguised herself as a pirate, knocking her over. After Chigg helped her up, she and three [[Jedi Initiate|Jedi younglings]] ultimately recovered the stolen fruit for the [[Jellyfruit Festival]] on the planet [[Tenoo]], which Chigg later attended. The Abednedo later was present on Tenoo for [[Visitor's Day]] and also visited the [[Restaurant|eatery]] [[Hap's Sap Tap]] on two occasions. Chigg and his [[Chigg's crew|crew]] gave up pirating and turned to selling exotic [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] fruits for a [[Merchant|living]]. When their group's [[Chigg's crew's ship|ship]] got stuck in mud on the planet [[Galjaero]], they sent out a [[distress signal]], which was answered by Durango and the [[Jedi]] [[youngling]]s [[Kai Brightstar]], [[Lys Solay]], and [[Nubs]]. Though their first attempt proved unsuccessful, Chigg helped Brightstar attach a [[Magnetic harpoon|tow cable]] to their ship, allowing Durango's vessel—the ''[[Crimson Firehawk]]''—to pull the craft to safety. Afterward, Chigg and his crew of former pirates visited the [[Starlight Beacon]] [[space station]] with the younglings. The Abednedo later attended the [[Starship Show]] on Tenoo, taking time to look at the [[XD-7 speedster]] [[starship]] display. Later, Chigg met his Jedi youngling friends and the [[Padawan]] [[Wes Vinik]] at [[Yarrum Tower]]. When the [[Ganguls]] pirates captured Vinik, Chigg pretended to join the group to save him. Eventually, Chigg succeeded in helping Brightstar, Solay, Nubs, and Vinik flee from the Ganguls' vessel. In another instance, the Ganguls [[Takeover of Yarrum Tower|commandeered]] control of Yarrum Tower, intending to force those present into their service. Chigg did not wish to return to pirating, so his Jedi youngling friends helped him escape the tower, with the assistance of Val Dorn. At some point between [[232 BBY]] and [[230 BBY]], Chigg was present on Tenoo prior to the [[Welcome Festival]]. ==Biography== ===Jellyfruit Festival=== {{Quote|Jellyfruit? Is that what it's called? Thing's delicious. Kid over there boosted a whole crate, and now he's selling 'em.|Chigg, to Kai Brightstar|}} [[Homeworld|Hailing from]] the [[planet]]''[[Star Wars: Aliens of the Galaxy]]'' [[Abednedo (planet)|Abednedo]] in the [[Colonies]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' Chigg was an [[Abednedo]] [[Gender|male]] [[pirate]] who hung around [[Yarrum Tower marketplace]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] planet [[Yarrum]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. Around the [[standard year|year]] [[233 BBY]],{{YJADate|1}} he bought a [[jellyfruit]] from the pirate [[Cyrus Vuundir|Taborr Val Dorn]] and his [[Taborr's gang|gang]]. While he was chomping on the [[fruit]], which he found scrumptious, the young [[pilot]] [[Nash Durango]], disguised as a pirate, collided with the imposing Abednedo and fell over. Chigg turned around, took a bite of the juice-dripping fruit, and greeted her, helping her get up and making sure she was alright. The Abednedo patted Durango on the head and apologized as he continued eating the fruit. One of Durango's other disguised companions, the [[Jedi Initiate|Jedi youngling]] [[Kai Brightstar]], asked in a put-on gruff voice where he acquired the fruit. [[File:Chigg-TJP.png|thumb|left|315px|Chigg makes sure Nash Durango is alright after helping her up.]] Chigg, who had not known the delicacy's name, pointed out Val Dorn and explained that the pirate had [[Thief|stolen]] a crate of them. Durango and the [[Jedi]] had come to Yarrum in search of the stolen goods, so another [[youngling]], [[Lys Solay]], thanked Chigg, though she initially forgot to imitate a pirate's deep voice. Chigg then walked off. Later, when the Jedi and Durango had re-acquired the fruit, Solay revealed that Val Dorn had stolen from an [[Weebo|old farmer]], which Chigg and some other pirates found particularly unimpressive. The pirates laughed at Val Dorn's gang and then walked away. That [[Local day|night]], Chigg and a [[Unidentified Twi'lek guard|Twi'lek pirate]] attended the [[Jellyfruit Festival]] on the planet [[Tenoo]], to which Durango had invited them in the spirit of including everyone, even pirates, in the merrymaking. Chigg enjoyed a jellyfruit and a beverage from the [[Restaurant|eatery]] [[Hap's Sap Tap]], operated by the [[Latero]] [[Hap]]. Afterward, due to the Jedi younglings' kindness, the Abednedo and his [[Chigg's crew|crew]] chose to stop stealing from others as pirates and instead gather and sell rare fruits from around the Outer Rim. Chigg was present on Tenoo again for [[Visitor's Day]], which attracted visitors from all over [[the galaxy]].{{YJA|Visitor's Day (episode)}} He later visited Hap's Sap Tap but eventually chose to leave alongside the establishment's other patrons when a [[Tikotiko]] creature spilled an [[Color|orange]]-colored beverage on him.{{YJA|Bad Eggs}} On another occasion, he and another patron sat at a table at the eatery and had their beverages spilled on them when a [[Holo-darts|holo-dart]]—thrown by the Jedi youngling [[Nubs]]—collided with his drink.{{YJA|Big Brother's Bounty}} ===Stuck on Galjaero=== {{Quote|Our ship got stuck in the mud. We sent out a distress call.''"
"''You mean the distress call we answered? Well, we're here to help.''"
"''Well, your friends don't look like they're helping much.|Chigg and Nash Durango|{{YJA|Stuck in the Muck}}}} [[File:DurangoChigg-YJA-StuckInTheMuck.png|thumb|right|300px|Chigg and Nash Durango recognized each other upon meeting on Galjaero.]] Later around the same [[Standard year|year]], Chigg and his crew of former pirates—including a [[Unidentified Chagrian pirate|Chagrian]], a [[Unidentified Kyuzo pirate|Kyuzo]], a [[Twi'lek]], and another [[Unidentified pirate (Chigg's crew)|individual]]—traveled to the planet [[Galjaero]] to acquire a rare type of fruit grown there. When their [[Chigg's crew's ship|ship]] got stuck in mud on the planet's surface, they sent a [[distress signal]]. The Abednedo left the immediate area to gather fruit while his colleagues unloaded crates from their craft to make it lighter. While Durango was transporting Solay, Nubs, and Brightstar to the [[Starlight Beacon]] [[space station]] aboard her ship, the ''[[Crimson Firehawk]]'', the group responded to the call for help. However, they assumed Chigg's colleagues were holding the ship's legitimate owners inside to steal their cargo and attacked the group. Durango and Chigg quickly informed their colleagues of the situation, with the latter assuring his crew that their rescuers were trustworthy because they had shared their jellyfruit with him on Tenoo. Working together, the Jedi younglings attempted to use [[the Force]] to [[Telekinesis|lift]] the ship out of the mud while Chigg and his crew used tools to pry it upward. However, the group's efforts accidentally pushed the vessel too far, causing a mudslide that sent it over a cliff and near the entrance to a [[Unidentified Galjaero creature|creature's]] den. As the creature's [[Limb|tentacles]] moved to drag the ship closer, Brightstar and Chigg prepared to attach a [[Magnetic harpoon|tow cable]] to the ship while it was distracted by their other friends throwing fruit at it. The Abednedo leapt atop of the pirate vessel and fastened the cable, allowing Durango to pull the starship free using the ''Firehawk''. [[File:YounglingsChigg-YJA-StuckInTheMuck.png|thumb|left|300px|Chigg (top right) visited Starlight Beacon with Brightstar, Solay, and Nubs.]] As his crew loaded their ship, Chigg inquired what had brought the Jedi near Galjaero to answer their call. Brightstar—noticing the Abednedo's excitement when he mentioned their destination—invited the former pirate to join them on Starlight Beacon. After the crew finished loading their ship, they traveled through [[hyperspace]] with the ''Firehawk'' to the station. Once there, he explained to [[Jedi Master]] [[Estala Maru]] that the younglings had been late due to answering his crew's distress call. Maru was surprised by their presence but nonetheless invited them to tour the facility with the other Jedi. ===Rescuing friends=== {{Quote|Phew! That was a close one, eh?''"
"''Wait. You're letting us go?''"
"''I was just pretending to join the Ganguls. I'd never turn on you three.|Chigg and Kai Brightstar, as the former rescued the latter, Lys Solay, and Nubs from the Ganguls|}} [[File:ChiggJedi-YJA.png|thumb|right|300px|Chigg and Kai Brightstar, Lys Solay, and Nubs at Yarrum Tower]] At another point, Chigg was present at Yarrum Tower and walked past while Brightstar, Solay, and Nubs were there searching for the [[droid]] [[0G-LC]]'s artifacts, which pirates had stolen.{{YJA|The Team Up}} On another occasion, Chigg attended the [[Starship Show]] exhibition event on Tenoo and looked at the display for an [[XD-7 speedster]] starship, owned by the human [[Luggs Neelo]].{{YJA|The Starship Show}} Later, Chigg met the three younglings and Jedi [[Padawan]] [[Wes Vinik]] at Yarrum Tower while the former group was on a supply run for Jedi Master [[Zia Zaldor Zanna]]. Although Vinik was skeptical that Chigg had renounced his pirate ways, the younglings insisted he and his crew only sold fruit. When Vinik returned to the tower's marketplace to finish their resupply list, he was captured by the Ganguls pirates, who had been in the tower recruiting pirates to join them. Seeing this, Chigg pretended to join them to get aboard their [[shuttle]]. Brightstar, Solay, and Nubs also snuck aboard the shuttle to rescue their friend, though the Ganguls also caught them in an [[Stun net|energy net]] when they tried to reach Vinik. The pirate [[Sellaccc Orryak]] ordered Chigg to dispose of the younglings, shocking the trio of his apparent joining of the Ganguls. The Abednedo publicly agreed to comply with the order and escorted the three away, but let them free of their [[magnetic binders]] and returned their [[lightsaber]]s once out of sight and instructed them to call Durango to meet them for a pickup on the planet [[Variax]], telling the younglings that he would meet them in the [[hangar]]. Afterward, Chigg left for the hangar and was spotted by Vinik, who expressed anger toward the Abednedo for apparently joining the pirates. The younglings revealed their presence as Durango arrived in her ship to rescue them, moments after the pirates arrived on Variax to steal ships from its [[Variax shipyard|shipyard]]. [[File:ChiggVinik-YJA.png|thumb|left|300px|Chigg and Wes Vinik escaping from the Ganguls]] In the ensuing skirmish, the vessel began tilting sharply to one side, causing Vinik to dangle from his binders, which were attached to a set of boarding stairs. From a walkway above the hangar floor, Chigg attacked two droids and stole an [[electrostaff]] from one, somersaulting onto a crate near Vinik. He reached out a hand to Vinik, though the Padawan indicated he did not trust the supposed pirate. Chigg ignited Vinik's [[Wes Vinik's lightsaber|lightsaber]] and cut the Padawan's restraints off, telling the latter that he had faked joining the Ganguls to help the younglings. Orryak expressed her disgust with Chigg's betrayal of the Ganguls, firing an energy net at him and Vinik, which attached harmlessly to the wall instead after the Abednedo dodged. Chigg told her that he was no longer a pirate and safely escaped the vessel on the ''Firehawk'' with his allies after dodging another energy net. After returning to Yarrum Tower, the Padawan thanked Chigg for his help and apologized for not trusting him earlier. Chigg accepted his apology and enveloped Vinik in a hug. ===Escaping Yarrum Tower=== {{Quote|I do not want to work for the Ganguls. They're pirates, and I chose not to be a pirate anymore.''"
"''Chigg, we won't let that happen. We're gonna get you out of here before the Ganguls find you.|Chigg and Lys Solay, after the Ganguls commandeered control of Yarrum Tower|{{YJA|Tower Run}}}} [[File:ChiggHiding-YJA.png|thumb|right|300px|Chigg, Lys Solay, Nubs, and Kai Brightstar hid in the former's fruit stall when the Ganguls seized Yarrum Tower.]] At another point, Chigg [[Merchant|operated]] a small [[Chigg's fruit stall (Yarrum)|stall]] at Yarrum Tower to sell some of his fruit. After a visit to a [[Unidentified jungle moon|moon]] near Yarrum, he brought back a selection of multicolored [[Berry|berries]] from his travels. He served the berries to Brightstar, Solay, and Nubs, who were delighted with the treat. As Chigg prepared to present the trio with another type of fruit to try, a [[detonator]] was thrown into the market area of Yarrum Tower, clouding the area with smoke. Chigg and the younglings swiftly dove behind the former's stall to hide, with the Abednedo also pulling its fabric-based roof down on top of them for further cover. The [[Ganguls]], led by [[Toda-Joh]], announced they were [[Takeover of Yarrum Tower|claiming]] Yarrum Tower as their own to use as their headquarters. The leader then gave orders to gather those present to force them to work for the Ganguls. Chigg quietly told the Jedi younglings with him that he did not want to become a pirate again. While Solay reassured Chigg he would not have to return to that way of life, the Abednedo suggested they could call Durango for help. Brightstar indicated it would take her too long to arrive, noting that they needed to leave while the Ganguls were distracted. The group decided to ask Taborr Val Dorn for help, knowing that he disliked the Ganguls as well. Val Dorn begrudgingly agreed to help them, as escaping the tower himself would be easier with assistance, though he told Chigg sternly that he was only helping for his own benefit. The group attempted to make their way to Val Dorn's ship, the ''[[Iron Talon]]'', though the path to the [[turbolift]] was blocked by pirates. Although Val Dorn wanted to take out the Ganguls' leadership, Brightstar indicated that evacuating Chigg was still their priority, as the Abednedo had made a choice not to be a pirate. [[File:ChiggNet-YJA.png|thumb|left|300px|Jooro Jarrot trapped Chigg and Nubs in an energy net.]] Chigg, Val Dorn, and the younglings eventually managed to sneak down the turbolift and make it to the airfield. However, Val Dorn decided to attack Orryak, prompting the pirate [[Jooro Jarrot]] to notice and trap Chigg and Nubs under an energy net. A fight ensued and Chigg and Nubs eventually managed to escape the net and board the ''Iron Talon''. Afterward, Chigg thanked the pirate for his help, though Val Dorn expressed no emotion in response. After returning to Tenoo, the younglings and Hap gathered around [[Chigg's fruit stall (Tenoo)|Chigg's fruit stall]] in [[Kublop Springs]], with Hap describing Chigg's stock of fruit as one of the best in the [[galaxy]]. Chigg thanked the Jedi younglings for helping him escape Yarrum Tower, with Solay sympathizing with the loss of his stall but expressing that she was glad he was safe. As the Jedi hugged him, Hap offered to whip up some [[fruit shake]]s at Hap's Sap Tap. At some point between [[232 BBY]] and [[230 BBY]],{{YJADate|307}} Chigg operated his fruit stand as the market area was busy with activity for the upcoming [[Welcome Festival]]. When the [[droidsmith]] [[Rek Minuu]] and his [[droid]] [[Apexx]] tried to sabotage the festival, Chigg stood with other town residents to oppose them. However, as more attacking droids approached, Chigg raised his hands and fled.{{YJA|Making Friends}} ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Oy! I'd love to visit Starlight Beacon some day. I've heard so much about it.''"
"''Well, what about today? Wanna come with us?''"
"''Oh, you bet I do. You hear that, sleemos? We're going to Starlight Beacon!|Chigg and Kai Brightstar|}} [[File:ChiggYounglings-YJA.png|thumb|right|300px|Chigg considered Kai Brightstar, Lys Solay, and Nubs his friends, willing to help free them from pirate capture.]] Despite being an imposing pirate, Chigg helped the young pilot Nash Durango get up and apologized for their collision. He laughed at Taborr Val Dorn's unremarkable piracy. Following the Jedi younglings' kindness at the Jellyfruit Festival, he and his crew gave up their pirating profession and opted to become traders of exotic Outer Rim fruits. The Abednedo was pleased to encounter Durango and the other younglings on Galjaero, working together with them to save his crew's ship. He also expressed excitement over the opportunity to visit Starlight Beacon, having heard many things about it. Chigg considered Kai Brightstar, Lys Solay, Nubs, and Durango his friends, and was pleased when he had the opportunity to see them. Although Jedi Padawan Wes Vinik was deeply skeptical toward him, the Abednedo nonetheless considered any individual who was a colleague of the Jedi younglings—which included Vinik—also a friend to him. To this end, even though he had given up pirating, he was willing to go undercover on the Ganguls' vessel to rescue the Padawan and later his youngling allies. The Jedi youngling trio displayed a similar level of loyalty toward him, helping Chigg escape from Yarrum Tower before he could be forced to work for the Ganguls. They respected his choice to give up piracy and pointed his change in behavior out to others, in the hopes they might follow the same path as the Abednedo. Chigg took pride in the exotic and rare fruits he and his crew found throughout the galaxy, often willing to share them with those he knew, alongside selling some to others. Chigg had patterned brown skin, green [[eye]]s, and white [[Hair|sideburns]]. ==Skills and abilities== {{Quote|I love traveling the galaxy and finding new foods to share. Found these little beauties on a jungle moon not far from here.|Chigg, about his occupation|}} Chigg was physically fit and competent in combat, able to wield an electrostaff. He was also capable of flying a starship and did so on numerous occasions as an exotic fruit dealer who traveled the galaxy frequently. In an attempt to free his friends from the Ganguls, Chigg was able to convincingly pose as a recruit of the pirate group for a short period, helping the Jedi younglings and Vinik escape. While operating as a pirate, Chigg proved capable of stealing from others but later decided to cease doing so. ==Equipment== {{Quote|Our ship got stuck in the mud. We sent out a distress call.|Chigg, to Nash Durango|}} Chigg wore a tattered green-and-white [[Clothing|shirt]] and pocketed brown pants. He also donned brown shoes, fingerless [[glove]]s, and a brown [[belt]] with a lighter-colored buckle and a side pouch. His crew owned a starship, which they used to transport exotic fruits across the galaxy. Chigg also operated exotic fruit stalls at Yarrum Tower and Kublop Springs. At one point, while rescuing his Jedi friends from the Ganguls, he wielded an electrostaff stolen from a droid. ==Behind the scenes== Chigg first appeared in "[[The Jellyfruit Pursuit]]," the first part of the [[The Jellyfruit Pursuit / Creature Safari|fifth episode]] in the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season One|first season]] of the [[Disney+]] animated television series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. He was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who also plays Jedi youngling Nubs in the series. The episode was released on [[May 4]], [[2023]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-may-2023|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in May 2023}} Artist [[Virgile Fondanaiche]] did modeling work for a scene in Yarrum Tower in which Chigg appeared, using the [[Wikipedia:Autodesk Maya|Autodesk Maya]] software.{{ArtStation|username=polysmooth|url=artwork/V2yXD5|name=[[Virgile Fondanaiche]]|text=Young Jedi Adventures - Season 2 | First Batch|date=2024-09-12}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Chigg}} *{{YJA|The Jellyfruit Pursuit}} {{1st}} *[[The Jellyfruit Pursuit (Little Golden Book)|''The Jellyfruit Pursuit'' Little Golden Book]] *{{YJA|Visitor's Day (episode)}} *{{YJA|Bad Eggs}} *{{YJA|Big Brother's Bounty}} *{{YJA|Stuck in the Muck}} *{{YJA|The Team Up}} *{{YJA|The Starship Show}} *{{YJA|The Jedi Rescue}} *{{YJA|Tower Run}} *{{YJA|Making Friends}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=チグ |nl=Chigg }} [[Category:Abednedo]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Merchants]] [[Category:Pirates]]
